title: record – one entry in a source (baptism, marriage, burial, registration …)
description: Verbatim transcript and interpretation live in the Markdown body (## Transcript, ## Interpretation). Participants are personas exactly as written – NOT persons in the tree (ADR 0017).

allOf.x-hint: use either crop or crops, not both

crop.description: Short form for a single crop: path relative to the record file, e.g. evidence/R-….jpg (same as crops: [{path: …}], ADR 0031).

crops.description: Evidence crops (small JPEG) of this entry, e.g. the entry and a margin note (ADR 0031).

path.description: relative to the record file, e.g. evidence/R-….jpg

caption.description: what the crop shows: entry, margin note, signature …

annotations.description: Later notes on the entry – in the margin or added afterwards, often by another hand (ADR 0032).

locator.description: Where exactly the entry is inside the source (ADR 0023). At least one of page, folio, entry or image; volume only narrows them down (ADR 0058).

volume.description: volume of the source, one of source.volumes when the source lists them

page.description: page as printed / as shown by the portal (pg)

image.description: image (scan) number in the portal viewer

locator.x-hint: needs at least one of page, folio, entry, image

reading.description: Reading state: read-once until a second, careful reading of the crop (ADR 0016). read_by = members (humans) who read it from the image; read_by_agent = read by an AI agent. Only a member who read it may confirm it (ADR 0033).

read_by_agent.description: Read by an AI agent: true, or the model name.

uncertain.description: Readings marked uncertain in the transcript with [ ].

annotation.description: One later note on the entry (ADR 0032). Text as written, with [ ] for uncertain readings.

position.description: margin, below the entry, another page …

hand.description: same hand as the entry, later hand, parish priest …

written.description: when the note was written, if dated or known

participant.description: A person as written in this record (persona).

status_as_written.description: other status as written, e.g. legitimate / illegitimate, house owner; marital status goes into marital_status_as_written (ADR 0046)

marital_status_as_written.description: marital status as written: ženatý, vdova, svobodná, coelebs, Witwer … (ADR 0046)

marital_status.description: normalised marital status (single, married, widowed, divorced) – only what the record states
